ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S001_001.en: Warchief, I do not intend to question your motives, but why are we going this way?

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S001_002.en: We seem to be heading away from the enemy and their settlements. I do not understand.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S001_003.en: The humans and their allies believe us to be mindless brutes. I intend to exploit that fact.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S001_004.en: Even now they sit in their walled castles and townships, expecting us to throw ourselves at their defenses with impunity. Instead, we will be doing exactly the opposite.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S001_005.en: Gaze upon the horizon, Rend, and behold the Thoradin Wall. This line of fortifications spreads across hundreds of miles and is said to have never been breached.  I have no intention of sacrificing our warriors to break through it.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S001_006.en: But why didn’t we just go around the mountains? Or use our ships to bypass the mainland?

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S001_007.en: Because Maim, they would be expecting us to try that as well.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S001_008.en: ...and... if we reach the Northlands through the mountains, we can cut off the elven supplies that the humans will desperately need.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S002_001.en: Warchief, I bring important news from Saurfang. We couldn’t break the gates of Ironforge, none of our weapons had any effect…

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S002_002.en: We have failed you warchief… and will accept whatever punishment you deem necessary...

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S002_003.en: Maintain the siege and let them starve. Send a rider with my words to Varok. The Burning Blade and the Bleeding Hollow clans will remain in Khaz modan to suppress any attempts to sabotage our armies and supplies. And you, Eitrigg, will join my army here, in Lordaeron.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S002_005.en: Pick up the pace warriors! We must get through these peaks as fast as possible!

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S003_002.en: One more week of marching and we be reaching da borders of Quel'Thalas…

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S003_003.en: ...though I be trying me best to keep myself composed, da prospect of revenge and justice be making my axes mighty restless…

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S003_004.en: And as I promised, your people shall have their vengeance, mighty Zul’jin. But before we can invade the elven lands, we must first strengthen our position here. My scouts have informed us that Alliance forces are gathering near the Darrowmere lake.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S003_005.en: I have ordered the Stormreaver and Twilight's Hammer clans to head up to the river bed. Gul'dan and Cho'gall will distract the Alliance while Maim and the Blacktooth Grin clan attack Tyr's Hand.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S003_006.en: That leaves Stratholme, the jewel in the north and Lordaeron’s second largest city. While it stands, it will be impossible to launch an assault on Quel’thalas.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S003_007.en: There be many troll hideouts in the forests between these mountains and Stratholme. If we find dem, dey will be needing little convincing to join da Horde.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S003_008.en: Excellent. Have no doubt Zul’jin, we will liberate your homeland… and slaughter those who wronged you.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S004_001.en: So the rumors are true, the troll leader did ally himself with the foreign beasts, we should warn the Thane.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S005_001.en: Warchief, I was told that you want to see me.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S005_002.en: Utok, travel north ahead of us to Darrowmere lake, Gul’dan and his clan are establishing a base camp on its shores as we speak. I want you to monitor his activities.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S005_003.en: It will be done, Warchief. Gul'dan and his lackeys shall obey your commands under my watch.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S005_004.en: Zul’jin, I’ve been informed that there is a Troll pack that has just entered our camp after hearing that you’ve accompanied us. They’re asking for an audience.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S006_001.en: Great Chieftain Zul'jin! We be from da Wilted Bark tribe. We bring word from our kin dat be figthing da dwarven clans in dese valleys. We heard that you gained a mighty ally that could help us win dis war.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S006_002.en: Greetings mighty sons of da Wilted Bark! What ya heard be true - with da Horde at our backs we will be bringing ruin to all who have wronged us… da dwarves of these lands included!

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S006_003.en: Praise da Loa! Ya arrival be timely mon, da bearded vermin been gaining da upper hand as of late. We’ve been feeling da touch of Bwonsamdi for months now.

ToD_A03_CNMC3_VO_S006_004.en: Gaining da upper hand eh? I believe it be time to shake things up a little den… what say ya? Ready for a little retribution?
